note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a No provision; A06b No provision; L05 No provision): no ordinary naturalisation by residence; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Generally applicable provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Generally applicable provision), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: Gender restriction: only if the father is also born in country), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: by birth in the territory only on the condition the dataset states; by descent from either parent, with no further limit on a child born abroad. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.
